blocks.text: Nostalgia goes hand in hand with the holidays. Think time spent with Lola and Lolo, sharing bibingka or puto-bumbong after Simbang Gabi, and strolling down streets illuminated by parols, vibrant Christmas lights, and colorful decorations. This is the Filipino Christmas we know and love–makulay, maningning, and, simply put, full of joy. This year, Kultura brings these cherished holiday memories to life with Kumukutikutitap: A Filipino Christmas Market. Experience the festivities from November 9 to 15 at the Main Mall Atrium, SM Mall of Asia for an all-in-one Christmas shopping destination, with gift options for every personality, style, and budget.
